cues.text: Before the daylight filled the sky

You sought the Father, drawing nigh
Before the streets awoke to day

You found a quiet place to pray
You brought each choice before His throne

And never faced the road alone
Jesus, teach our hearts to see

The strength You found on bended knee
Lead us to the Father

Teach us how to pray
In our joy and in our sorrow

Turn our hearts His way
When the words will not come easy

When we don't know what to say
Jesus, lead us to the Father
Teach us how to pray

Beneath the shadow of the night
You knelt 'neath the soft lamp light

You brought Him sorrow, grief and fear
And knew the Father would still draw near

You chose His will above Your own
And faced the cross, but not alone

When answers wait and hope feels small
Teach us to trust the Lord of all

Lead us to the Father
Teach us how to pray

In our joy and in our sorrow
Turn our hearts His way

When the words will not come easy
When we don't know what to say

Jesus, lead us to the Father
Teach us how to pray

Father, may Your kingdom come
Father, may Your will be done

Give us what we need today
Forgive us with Your Holy grace

Spirit, help us in our need
Christ has made a way to speak

We are children, we are known
We do not come before You alone

Lead us to the Father
Teach us how to pray

In our joy and in our sorrow
Turn our hearts His way

When the words will not come easy
When we don't know what to say

Jesus, lead us to the Father
Teach us how to pray

Jesus, lead us to the Father
Teach us how to pray
